info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Delete Ecommerce Cart Remove-v5-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Removal API enables merchants to efficiently manage their customers' shopping carts by allowing the removal of items from the cart. This operation is crucial for updating the cart's contents based on customer changes or preferences. Typical users include ecommerce application developers and platform integration specialists aiming to refine the user experience by ensuring that the cart reflects the latest selections. By utilizing this API, businesses can maintain accurate cart data while enhancing customer satisfaction.

delete.summary: Remove an item from the shopping cart.
delete.description: This endpoint allows developers to remove a specified item from the user's shopping cart. Ensure that the item exists in the cart before attempting to remove it. A successful request will update the cart accordingly and return the updated state.

requestBody.description: Contains the necessary information to remove an item from the shopping cart.

204.description: The item has been successfully removed from the cart.

DeleteEcommerceCartRemoveRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for removing an item from the shopping cart. It is expected to be a string.

DeleteEcommerceCartRemoveResponse_204.title: Cart Removal Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cart item removal was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the removal operation.

resultId.description: The ID of the operation result.

state.description: Current state of the item in the cart.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the request.

DeleteEcommerceCartRemoveResponse_204.description: Response schema for the operation of removing an item from the cart.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user or system responsible for the action.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the action was performed.

automated.description: Indicates whether the removal was performed by an automated process.

AuditInfo.description: Details about the audit trail of the removal operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
